treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Belgium and the State of Israel for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1972)
eif_quote: L'échange des instruments de ratification prévu à l'article 28 de la Convention a eu lieu à Bruxelles le 20 octobre 1975. Conformément aux dispositions du même article 28, ces actes entreront en vigueur le 4 novembre 1975.
source_title: Bulletin des Contributions n° 535 (1975) – Loi du 2 juin 1975 portant approbation de la Convention Belgique–Israël (Moniteur belge 1.11.1975), French translation; KU Leuven archive copy

rates.quote: mais l'impôt ainsi établi ne peut excéder 15 pour cent du montant brut des dividendes.
mais l'impôt ainsi établi ne peut excéder 15 pour cent du montant brut des intérêts.
mais l'impôt ainsi établi ne peut excéder 10 pour-cent du montant des redevances.

ppt.basis: MLI art. 7(1) (per treaty map; synthesised text not read)

notes: Authentic text is English only; quotes are from the official French translation published in the Belgian Finance Ministry's Bulletin des Contributions (archived PDF, OCR; e.g. 'pour-cent'). Art. 12(4): copyright royalties for literary, dramatic, musical, artistic or scientific works (excluding cinema/TV films) taxable only in the residence State (0% at source) — not modelled; 10% applies to patents, trademarks, designs, secret formulas, cinema/TV films, equipment, know-how and bare-boat charter. Art. 10(3): for Belgium, 'dividends' include income (even paid as interest) taxable as income from capital invested by partners in non-share companies; such interest excluded from Art. 11. Art. 11(3): interest on current accounts/advances between banks of the two States falls under Art. 7. No beneficial-ownership requirement in Arts. 10–12. Art. 28(2): applies in Belgium to WHT on income attributed/paid from 1 January 1975; in Israel to fiscal years beginning on/after 1 April 1975. MLI: both Parties list the treaty; treaty map MLI WHT effect 2020-01-01; synthesised text not obtained, so MLI modifications (incl. any Art. 8) unverified. No amending protocol known (treaty map).
